Marta: Heads-up: packaging ready for RC6 private/VPC canary. Sealed bundle built, cosigned, and staged to offsite-escort. Need deploy-bot run for transport handoff during next change window (02:00-04:00 UTC).

Vincent: Can you paste the sealed bundle SHA and manifest epoch? Also we must pin the installer image (no :latest promotion).

Marta: Upload details:
SHA256: abcdef1234567890deadbeefcafebabe1111112222333344445555666677778888
manifest_epoch: 2026-03-21-rc6
installer_image: registry.redwood.internal/private-installer@sha256:1111aaaabbbbcccc1111aaaabbbbcccc2222
cosign: signed by kms://projects/redwood/keys/release-signer
transport_checksums: s3://release-escrow/rc6/checksums.txt

deploy-bot: @channel starting escort handshake: creating transport-ticket, sealing manifest.

[deploy-bot log]
---
creating ticket id=escort-4390012345
uploading sealed bundle -> offsite://escort/rc6/2026-03-21.tar.gz
cosign verify: OK
checksum verify: OK (sha256: abcdef1234...)
---
Run: `deploybot release create --channel private-vpc --manifest manifest_epoch=2026-03-21-rc6 --pin installer=@sha256:1111aaaabbbbcccc1111aaaabbbbcccc2222`

Sophia: Airgap preflight Q: cosign TTL currently set to 90d — security asked for 30d rotation for this customer. For canary do we shorten it?

Vincent: For canary let's set TTL=7d and schedule signer rotation post-cutover. Also define rollback triggers: canary CPU > 80% OR error-rate > 3% sustained for 5m -> auto-fallback to RC5 pin.

eng-release-oncall: Confirming change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll start canary monitoring at 02:05 and will create an incident channel if thresholds trip. Do NOT promote to full fleet until canary is green.

Marta: Ack. Holding final promotion until canary signal. Draft release notes (for later):
- RC6 (private/VPC installer): fixes packager checksum race, improves KMS handshake reliability, reduces cosign TTL to 7d for canary.
- Known issue: kube-proxy metrics may spike under high pod churn; rollback criteria documented.

Ryan: Please add explicit fallback pin in the deploy config: `fallback_image: registry.redwood.internal/private-installer@sha256:0000deadbeefcafefeed0000deadbeef9999`

Vincent: Also ensure transport ticket has escrow TTL >= 48h and that ops has the escrow access list updated.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: packaging handshake complete -> ticket=escort-4390012345 status=sealed. Next step: manual canary start by eng-release-oncall. :thumbsup:

Marta: Thanks — I'll update the release notes and ping infra to prep KMS rotation window.

eng-release-oncall: I'll kick canary at 02:05 UTC and post canary status here. If all good, we'll move to staged rollout at 03:30 UTC.

(End of thread)
